payload.summary: The scheme in force, published on 12 February 2026 — the day after Cabinet agreed it — as a full web page rather than a download. A summary of changes at the top is followed by nine numbered sections and five appendices covering who can apply, the five priority bands, how homes are advertised and bid for, and how to challenge a decision. The summary states in the council's own words that the updates “have been shaped through a public consultation which took place in Autumn 2025 and scrutiny by the council's Overview and Scrutiny Committee”.
